Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<'EOF'
Implement psl assert always after_reset\(rst\) with corrected encoding

The initial encoding used `past_reset OR NOT\(rst\)`, which caused past_reset
to latch immediately if rst started at 0 — before reset ever fired. The
correct encoding uses a `rst_ever_high` sticky register:

  next_rst_ever_high = rst_ever_high OR rst   \(latches once rst goes HIGH\)
  effective = NOT\(rst_ever_high\) OR rst OR property

This gives three tiers of vacuousness:
  - NOT\(rst_ever_high\): vacuous before any reset
  - rst:               vacuous during active reset
  - property:          real check only after rst has fired AND gone low

BMC \(Z3\) correctly starts from zero-initialized registers, observes rst
fire, then checks the property on all subsequent cycles. IC3 is skipped
\(unconstrained initial states cause spurious CEX\).

Changes:
- mlir.go: fix emitAfterResetAssertion with rst_ever_high encoding
- grammar.js / parser: psl_after_reset_assertion rule \(already present\)
- ast.go, extractor.go: PslAfterResetAssertion \(already present\)
- compile.sh: skip IC3 when after_reset present \(already present\)
- examples/vhd/test_after_reset.vhd: sticky_high design, BMC passes
- verif-extensions.md: mark after_reset as done, document encoding
- copy_code.sh: add test_after_reset.vhd to paste buffer

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Fix contract verification pipeline in compile.sh

Root cause: circt-bmc cannot process verif.contract directly because its
ConvertHWToSMT pass converts all hw.modules to func.funcs. The apply-mode
hw.module emitted by --lower-contracts contains verif.symbolic_value, which
is no longer inside an hw.module after SMT conversion, failing the dialect
validator.

Fix pipeline \([2c/3]\):
  1. circt-opt --lower-contracts  → verif.formal check blocks + apply-mode hw.module
  2. Python extraction             → keep only verif.formal blocks \(drop the hw.module\)
  3. circt-bmc on verif.formal    → handled by its internal LowerTestsPass

For step [2a/3] \(BMC of PSL assertions alongside contracts\):
  - Use --strip-contracts to remove verif.contract before passing to circt-bmc
  - Skip BMC entirely for contract-only designs \(no verif.assert\)

Add test_contract.vhd \(verified\) and test_contract_fail.vhd \(caught violation\).
